prompt: A gaunt aristocratic vampire with leathery charcoal-black bat wings spread wide, hovering airborne above a cobblestone courtyard at night. He grips a limp peasant victim by the throat in one clawed hand, lifting the body off the ground; the victim is greyish, drained, sagging, head lolling back, while the vampire arches with renewed strength, his pale wine-purple skin flushed and engorged from feeding, fangs bared and bloodied. Crimson blood threads from the wound. He wears tattered velvet finery with gold-thread embroidery. The background is a moonlit gothic courtyard with a stone manor and bare trees; the only light is cold blue moonlight haloing his wings.

A monstrous vampire lord mid-flight, vast ribbed bat wings flared, suspended in a black night sky. His mouth gapes with long fangs streaked in crimson blood. Below and beneath him a small human corpse falls away limp and greyish, drained of life, tumbling toward the ground. The vampire looms larger and more powerful, pale violet flesh taut over corded muscle, claws outstretched, tattered dark cloak streaming. The background is a moonlit graveyard far below with crooked headstones and a pale full moon; cold moonlight rims his wings against the dark.

A gaunt aristocratic vampire with leathery wine-red bat wings spread wide, hovering airborne above a cobblestone courtyard at night. The background is a moonlit gothic manor courtyard with bare trees and a pale full moon; cold blue moonlight haloing his wings.
